scope: Controlled-clock source integration with real task/native SQLite and inert SDK, desktop and provider edges. No installed model or physical reboot qualification.
observed_behavior: Fresh observed worker boot creates a versioned allowance in the original deadline checkpoint.
Clean Stop tightens the cap before hashing its post-save receipt.
Changed-boot selection is read-only; owned activation commits remaining time before the paused snapshot.
A confirmed read survived changed-boot recovery; three total provider calls produced one output write.
Original objective, creation context, native history, effects and consumed counters were preserved.
Same-current-boot reopening retained its exact deadline; expired or unclean changed boots were refused.
The actual worker entry accepted a committed episode and refused a mismatched boot or deadline before native database/provider activity.
Explicit Continue preserved the expired budget in its sealed predecessor and omitted it from the separately authorized successor.

preserved_failed_attempts.cause: Three new tests incorrectly treated the existing host lock as a context manager; each also reported a cleanup error.
preserved_failed_attempts.correction: Test-only contextlib.closing; six affected store tests passed afterward. Imported fixture classes were changed to module imports to avoid duplicate discovery.

preserved_failed_attempts.scope: Initial combined batch including actual worker startup
preserved_failed_attempts.cause: The new fixture changed the legacy report task ID without an explicit TaskSpec; production correctly refused startup.
preserved_failed_attempts.correction: The fixture now preserves its original report contract and supplies boot context through normal preparation. Five worker checks and the combined 123-test batch passed afterward.

limits: The first path assumes a valid system clock and an existing clean Stop checkpoint.
Legacy tasks are not retrofitted with missing expiry metadata.
Continue successors, crash recovery, sleep, hibernation and Fast Startup remain separate qualification cases.
These source checks do not qualify M3 desktop performance, a full M5 lifecycle milestone or other engine/agent integrations.
